senses.gloss: to break through, pass through (Ex. XXXVI, 33). Denom. בָּרִיחַ.

units: <cite ref="Eruvin 13b:13">Erub. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>הבּוֹרֵחַ מן הגדולה</he> he who flees office.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 13:1:14">Y. Yeb. XIII, 13ᶜ</cite>, a. e. <he>בְּרַח מן ג׳ וכ׳</he> shun three things.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:18">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="B01128"><he>בָּקַע</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause to flee, drive out, exclude. Y. Yeb. XV, 15ᵃ top להַבְרִיחוֹ מנכסיו to force him to flee and abandon his property. Y. Gitt. V, 47ᵃ אדם מַבְרִיחַ עצמו מן השבועה one will try to shirk the responsibilities of a guardian on account of the oath (which the court asks of him) but one will not do so on account of payment (to which he may eventually be subjected, v. Tosaf. to B. Kam. 39ᵇ).

units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 113a:16">B. Kam. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ את המכס</he> to smuggle. Y. Keth. VI, beg. 30ᶜ <he>שלא תהא מַבְרֶחֶת משל וכ׳</he> that she should not take stealthily something which belongs to her husband.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:56">Lam. R. to I, 21</cite> <he>הוּבְרְחוּ ענני וכ׳</he> the clouds of glory were withdrawn (<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 3a:1">R. Hash. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>נסתלקו</he>).
